# Meadow (`meadow`)

Rolling summer fields in the wind under a big sky; can follow the real sun, moon and weather.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location, weather
- Cost: medium (~3.2 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Meadow, Rolling Hills, Tall Grass, Hillside

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `wind` | Wind | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `flowers` | Wildflowers | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.7 |
| `clouds` | Clouds | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `hour` | Time of Day | slider | 0 … 24 (step 0.25) | 15.5 |
| `lapse` | Time Lapse | slider | 0 … 60 (step 1) | 0 |
| `weather` | Weather | menu | 0 Live · 1 Clear · 2 Partly Cloudy · 3 Overcast · 4 Fog · 5 Rain · 6 Storm · 7 Snow | 0 (Live) |
| `landscape` | Landscape | menu | 0 Meadow · 1 Rolling Hills · 2 Tall Grass · 3 Hillside | 0 (Meadow) |
| `glow` | Glow | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `dither` | Dither | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
